LanguageData.MustBeUnderRoof: Must be placed under a roof.
LanguageData.MustBeNextToWall: Must be placed against a wall.
LanguageData.baseViewRangeDesc: Vision range before pawn capacities, lighting, weather and other vision modifiers.
LanguageData.buildingVisionModDesc: Scale the range of buildings that provide vision. Does not alter their placement preview.
LanguageData.NeedWatcherDesc: Surveillance cameras need a working, staffed console to provide vision.
LanguageData.wildLifeTabVisibleDesc: Include animals outside current sight in the wildlife tab. This reveals their presence.
LanguageData.aiSmart: Limit enemy targeting to their sight
LanguageData.aiSmartDesc: Humanlike enemies use their own fog visibility when choosing targets.
LanguageData.hideSpeakBubbleDesc: Hide Interaction Bubbles messages from pawns outside current sight.
LanguageData.NoCameraConsole: The camera console isn't built or being used
LanguageData.censorMode: Hide that little 17x28 pixels image for the puritan
LanguageData.allyGiveVision: Allies and neutral pawns provide vision
LanguageData.fogAlphaSetting_desc: Darkness over explored terrain outside current sight.
LanguageData.fogFadeSpeedSetting_desc: Choose how quickly fog fades when sight changes. Disabled changes it immediately.
LanguageData.doVolumeCheck: Should sounds outside the fog be muffled
LanguageData.audioSourceRangeDesc: Maximum distance in tiles for hearing-filtered sounds outside sight.
LanguageData.volumeMufflingModifierDesc: How much volume is lost as a hidden source approaches the hearing limit.
LanguageData.doFilthRevealDesc: Filth spawned under fog will remain invisible until you reveal that tile.
LanguageData.onlyOutsideColonyDesc: Show current information everywhere on player home maps. Other maps still use fog.
LanguageData.delayAlertsUntilSeen: Delay messages and letters until seen
LanguageData.delayAlertsUntilSeenDesc: Queue messages and letters about hidden targets until a target is in sight. Colony health events and events without a map target remain immediate.
LanguageData.clearFogDuringTargetingDesc: Temporarily reveal the map during gravship takeoff, landing selection and landing. This can reveal unseen information.
LanguageData.treesBlockSightDesc: Trees at least 50% grown block sight. Young trees and stumps do not.
LanguageData.treesBlockSight_RequiresReload: Change tree blocking before loading a game. Reload after changing it.
